note: THE NAMED BASELINES. A baseline is the thing a result is read AGAINST; each one here is a NAME, an explicit checkpoint and the ledger entry that set it. Read them through agents.training.baselines (never by copying a path), change one with `python -m main.baselines set <name> <run>/<file>.zip --reason "<ledger title>"`, and validate everything with `python -m main.baselines check`. The checkpoint is ALWAYS explicit (a .zip, a .json, or @<step>) so gen3_last_snapshot_resolution_v1 cannot move what a name points at.

production.purpose: THE ARCHITECTURE SURFACE production runs. designs/production_config.json is CONSTRUCTED from this run's config — migrated v97 -> v109 with the 13-key critic override block below — and ARCHITECTURE.md, the delivery graph, the compile gate and the arch viewer are all generated from that mirror.

production.notes: THE MIRROR IS CONSTRUCTED, NOT COPIED (CHANGELOG -> production_config_2026-09-06; provenance in designs/production_config.README.md). gen-17 supplies the whole architecture SURFACE; the critic block is overridden to the win-prob era. Non-critic keys changed: ZERO. The entry names gen-17 rather than the era arm because the SURFACE is the thing every derived artifact reads, and because ai_v12_02_winprob_critic had not written a model_config.json when the mirror was built. It moves to ai_v12_02_winprob_critic once that arm passes its critic gate — see `pending`. Why the surface half matters: the era's FIRST arm launched from a design-doc block with a 38-flag argv, and 31 architecture fields silently reverted to their OFF defaults; mirroring it would have redefined production BY OMISSION, with the delivery graph dropping 60 of 120 nodes and every derived artifact agreeing.

famine_comparator.purpose: The FAMINE PRE-TEST's comparator: does terminal-only reward learn at the incumbent's rate? Read at matched SNAPSHOT COUNT against the win-prob arm.
famine_comparator.set_by: 2026-09-06 · BASELINES REGISTRY — the named baselines become first-class objects (gen3_baselines_registry_v1)
famine_comparator.notes: FLOOR = 38 Elo, and NOT the adjacent-node spread (172/186, dominated by the 2M->4M jump — steep early LEARNING, not noise). 38 is the max |delta| between gen17 and rev-1 at matched steps over 8 nodes (the max, never the mean); the ladder se (+/-9-10) was rejected as fit error on one node. The two runs are not true replicates, so 38 likely OVER-states pure noise — conservative in the right direction for a kill rule. AND-gated with win_rate_vs_bots not rising. Same run as v9_long_baseline, a DIFFERENT name because the two roles move independently.
